name: dsh-session-translator
description: Translates English thinking blocks into Chinese using the model channels already configured in Harness — no separate setup. Translations persist with the session (no repeat cost, no leftovers), a fallback route takes over when the primary fails, and system error notices are translated too. Zero runtime dependencies.
author: maomao299 <2994650874@qq.com> (https://github.com/2994650874-coder)

scripts.test: node tools/smoke.mjs && node tools/live-lock-check.mjs && node tools/err-i18n-test.mjs && node tools/select-safe-test.mjs && node tools/host-integration.mjs && node tools/parity-check.mjs && node tools/browser-check.mjs

dshhub.summary: 用 Harness 上已配置的模型渠道翻译英文思考过程，无需单独配置。译文随会话存储、不重复翻译也不残留；主路由失败自动切备用；系统报错也一并译出。
